title: Foresee the Thunder Tribunal Acropolis: Ascension Seal
description: Foresee the Thunder Tribunal Acropolis: Ascension Seal is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through The Laurel-Sky Gate (Stable Gate with oracle vapor leakage). One selected deity from Zeus, Artemis, Ares, Athena enters; this beat spotlights Artemis as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the boss step at Thunder Tribunal Acropolis, using floating tribunal arena and oracle theater pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Celestial Heights of Olympus is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use living marble-light bodies, bronze cuirasses, laurel circuits, aegis scales, thunder tribunal auras, oracle smoke, amphitheater armor curves, hoplite shield geometry, winged victory accents, gold-blue skyfire, carved but non-readable relief bands..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Thunder Tribunal Acropolis and reveals: A partial verdict asking whether the Gates protect Olympus or expose it. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Thunder Tribunal Acropolis configured as a boss space inside floating tribunal arena and oracle theater; source-culture appearance layer: laurel trial arenas, marble sky platforms, oracle smoke lanes, aegis tribunal shields, thunder verdict courts; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: aegis laurel spears, living marble bronze cuirasses, oracle ambrosia cores, Athena countermeasure silhouettes
